name: EasySecure LoginRegistration Form – Inline & Modal Popup
author: imminentsoftwares

sections.description:
EasySecure LoginRegistration Form – Inline & Modal Popup is a modern, lightweight, and security-focused WordPress authentication plugin that allows users to log in, register, and reset passwords directly from the frontend using AJAX — without page reloads.

Designed for performance and usability, the plugin supports both inline forms via shortcode and modal popup login triggers. It includes advanced security features like Google reCAPTCHA v3 and mandatory email verification, ensuring only verified users can access your website.

With customizable fields, email templates, redirection settings, and flexible design options, EasySecure helps you create a seamless and professional login experience on any WordPress site.

Perfect for membership sites, business websites, communities, and eCommerce platforms.

Key Features

  • AJAX-based login, registration, and password reset
  • Inline form shortcode & modal popup trigger
  • Mandatory email verification (admin and user controlled)
  • Custom registration fields (text, number, email, dropdown, checkbox)
  • Google reCAPTCHA v3 integration for spam protection
  • Fully customizable email notifications
  • Redirect control after login, logout, and registration
  • Option to change the form’s primary theme color
  • Tab display type selector (icons or text for Login/Register tabs)
  • Custom logo upload for branded authentication forms
  • Fully responsive, mobile-friendly design
  • Compatible with any WordPress theme
  • Lightweight, fast, and built for performance

External Services

This plugin uses Google reCAPTCHA to detect and prevent spam and automated abuse.
The user’s reCAPTCHA token is securely sent to Google for verification.

Service Provider: Google
Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/loginregistration-form/’ directory, or install it directly from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Use the shortcode ‘[customsecurelr_login_registration]’ to display the form inline on any page or post.
  4. Add the class ‘customsecurelr-popup-trigger’ to any button or link to launch the modal login/register popup.
sections.faq:
How do I display the login/registration form?

Use the shortcode:
‘[customsecurelr_login_registration]’

Can I open the login form in a popup?

Yes. Simply add the class ‘customsecurelr-popup-trigger’ to any button or link.

Is email verification required?

Yes. Users must verify their email before accessing the site, improving security and preventing fake registrations.

Does it support Google reCAPTCHA?

Absolutely. reCAPTCHA v3 is integrated to help block spam and automated abuse.

Can I customize registration fields?

Yes. Create unlimited custom fields from the admin settings.

Can I brand the form with my logo?

Yes. Upload a custom logo directly from the plugin settings for a professional look.
